Criterion: Verify that the air vehicle structure is designed such that the power or thrust of the installed propulsion system is commensurate with the ground and flight conditions of intended use, including system failures, and the capabilities of the propulsion system and crew. Standard: See 5.1.1. Method of Compliance: See 5.1.1. References: (Navy/Air Force fixed wing) JSSG-2006: A.3.2.17, A.4.2.17 (Army rotary wing) ADS-29 (cancelled) (Navy rotary wing) As identified in JSSG-2006: A.3.2.17, A.4.2.17; and as identified in the Addendum to the AVPS for the respective air vehicle and/or AR-56, AR-89, and MIL-D-23222
